objects.name: Observed Asset
objects.description: This Category contains different types of Asset which can be observed as part of a potential incident.

objects.name: Observed Asset Descriptor
objects.description: This Category contains different ways to describe an Asset's features or settings.

objects.name: Identity Descriptor
objects.description: This Category contains ways to document a presented Identity.

objects.name: Offline Participant
objects.description: This Category contains types of offline participant (i.e. individuals and institutions) who can be observed as part of a potential incident.

objects.name: Interact with Publication, Asset, or Content
objects.description: This Category contains actions which relate to Publications, Assets, or Content.

objects.name: Action Available to Platforms
objects.description: This Category contains actions which are available only to Platforms.

objects.name: Offline Action
objects.description: This Category contains actions which are available offline.

objects.name: Action Detail
objects.description: This Category contains details about actions taken.

objects.name: Publication Details
objects.description: This Category contains information about an online publication.

objects.name: Content Origin
objects.description: This Category contains information about the origin of content.

objects.name: Narrative Detail
objects.description: This Category contains different types of narrative information.

objects.name: Content Effect
objects.description: This Category contains different impacts content can have.

objects.name: Content Detail
objects.description: This Category contains details about observed content.

objects.name: Narrative Theme
objects.description: This Category contains recurring narrative themes which are commonly observed in influence operations.

objects.name: Offline Material
objects.description: This Category contains material used in offline activity.

objects.name: User Asset
objects.description: This Category contains different types of user which can take action online.

objects.name: Account Asset
objects.description: The Asset is a user account.

objects.name: Admin Account Asset
objects.description: The Asset is an administrator account.

objects.name: Unauthenticated Account Asset
objects.description: The Asset is an unauthenticated / guest account on a Platform which does not mandate account creation to take actions on it.

objects.name: Community Asset
objects.description: The Asset is an online community in which users can interact with each other.

objects.name: Online Community Group
objects.description: The Asset is a 'group' created using a Platform's native features (e.g. Facebook Group).

objects.name: Online Community Page
objects.description: The Asset is a 'page' created using a Platform's native features (e.g. Facebook Page).

objects.name: Chat Community Server
objects.description: The Asset is a collection of chat rooms and/or chat broadcast groups organised into a server (e.g. a Discord or Slack server).

objects.name: Chat Room
objects.description: The Asset is a closed group where three or more users can send messages to each other.

objects.name: Chat Broadcast Group
objects.description: The Asset is a closed group where 'administrators' can send messages to a community who may react to, comment on, or forward the messages.

objects.name: Community Sub-Forum
objects.description: The Asset is a sub-forum on a community forum platform (e.g. a Subreddit).

objects.name: Online Game Session
objects.description: The Asset is a session for an online game (e.g. a Roblox or Minecraft server).

objects.name: Community Hosting Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform which is primarily designed for users to interact with each other as part of a community.

objects.name: Social Media Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Social Media Platform (e.g. Facebook, Instagram).

objects.name: Chat Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Chat Platform (e.g. Whastapp, Discord).

objects.name: Microblogging Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Microblogging Platform (e.g. Twitter, TikTok, BlueSky).

objects.name: Legacy Online Forum Platform
objects.description: The Asset is an old-school forum (e.g. Something Awful, War Thunder).

objects.name: Community Forum Platform
objects.description: The Asset is an Online Community Forum (e.g. Reddit).

objects.name: Image Board Platform
objects.description: The Asset is an Image Board Platform (e.g. 4chan).

objects.name: Question and Answer Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Q&A Platform (e.g. Quora).

objects.name: Online Game Platform
objects.description: The Asset is an Online Game Platform (e.g. Roblox, Minecraft).

objects.name: Dating Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Dating Platform (e.g. Tinder, Grindr).

objects.name: Content Hosting Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform which is primarily designed for users to upload and consume content.

objects.name: Website Asset
objects.description: The Asset is a collection of associated webpages under a single domain.

objects.name: Paste Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for sharing plaintext (e.g. Pastebin).

objects.name: Video Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for publishing and viewing video-based content (e.g. YouTube, Vimeo).

objects.name: Audio Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for publishing and listening to audio-based content (e.g. Spotify, Soundcloud, PodBean).

objects.name: Live Streaming Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for users to stream live content to their audience (e.g. Twitch, Kick).

objects.name: Software Delivery Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for publishing and downloading software (e.g. Apple App Store, Google Play Store, Steam).

objects.name: File Hosting Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for hosting and sharing files online (e.g. Google Drive, Dropbox).

objects.name: Wiki Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for online knowledge management (e.g. Wikipedia).

objects.name: Content Subscription Service Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform designed for allowing users to charge a subscription for content, access, or other benefits (e.g. Patreon, OnlyFans).

objects.name: Blog Asset
objects.description: The Asset is a blog in which people post typically informal articles.

objects.name: Digital Service Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform which is primarily designed to provide a digital service to their users.

objects.name: Blog Hosting Service Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform which hosts Blogs (e.g. Medium, Substack).

objects.name: Website Hosting Service Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform which hosts Websites (e.g. Webflow, Weebly, Wix).

objects.name: Email Service Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform which provides Email service (e.g. GMail, Proton Mail, Microsoft Office).

objects.name: Link Shortening Service Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Link Shortening Service provder (e.g. Bitly, TinyURL).

objects.name: Online Advertising Platform
objects.description: The Asset is an Online Advertising platform (e.g. Meta Ads, Google Ads, Amazon Ads).

objects.name: Search Engine Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Search Engine Platform (e.g. Google, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia).

objects.name: AI LLM Platform
objects.description: The Asset is an AI LLM provider (e.g. LeChat, Claude, Gemini).

objects.name: AI Media Platform
objects.description: The Asset is an AI Media generator (e.g. Midjourney, DALL-E, Gemini).

objects.name: Financial Service Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform which primarily provides financial services to its users (e.g. a bank, payment processor, or digital wallet provider).

objects.name: Job Platform
objects.description: The Asset is a Platform primarily designed for advertising and applying for employment opportunities (e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor).

objects.name: Multiple Assets
objects.description: Multiple online assets are documented as participants in the observed incident.

objects.name: Asset Configuration
objects.description: This Category contains ways to describe how an Asset has been configured.

objects.name: Verified Asset
objects.description: The Asset displays an indicator that it has been verified by the Platform it operates on.

objects.name: Lookalike Asset ID
objects.description: The Asset has an identifier (e.g. account handle) which is visually similar to another asset's identifier.

objects.name: Lookalike Domain
objects.description: The observed Platform has a domain which is visually similar to another Platform's domain (AKA typosquat).

objects.name: Asset Description
objects.description: This Category contains ways to describe how an Asset has described itself (e.g. a User or Community's biography field, a Platform's 'About us' page).

objects.name: Asset Imagery
objects.description: This Category contains ways to describe the imagery with which an Asset has been configured.

objects.name: Copied Asset Imagery
objects.description: The Asset uses imagery which is the same as imagery already used by another Asset.

objects.name: Mimicked Asset Imagery
objects.description: The Asset uses imagery which is visually similar (but not the same as) imagery already used by another Asset (e.g. mimicking colour scheme, typography).

objects.name: Animal Profile Picture
objects.description: The User has an animal set as their profile picture.

objects.name: Scenery Profile Picture
objects.description: The User has scenery set as their profile picture.

objects.name: Illustrated Character Profile Picture
objects.description: The User has an illustrated character (e.g. Anime, Manga, Cartoon) set as their profile picture.

objects.name: Attractive Person Profile Picture
objects.description: The User has an attractive person set as their profile picture.

objects.name: Platform Capability
objects.description: This Category contains ways to document different Capabilities a Platform may have.

objects.name: Payment Processing Capability
objects.description: The Platform has the capability to proccess one time payments.

objects.name: Subscription Processing Capability
objects.description: The Platform has the capability to process payments on a recurring, automated basis.

objects.name: Email Service Capability
objects.description: The Platform has the capability to send and receive emails.

objects.name: Encrypted Communication Capability
objects.description: Communications sent on this platform are encrypted.

objects.name: Asset Gating
objects.description: This Category contains ways to describe how access to an Asset is gated.

objects.name: Gated Asset
objects.description: The Asset prevents access to it in some way (i.e. it is 'gated').

objects.name: Invite Gated Asset
objects.description: The Asset cannot be accessed by users unless the user is invited to access it.

objects.name: Approval Gated Asset
objects.description: The Asset cannot be accessed by users unless they use a Platform's feature to request access to it, and that request is approved.

objects.name: Geoblocked Asset
objects.description: The Asset is configured to prevent access to users from specified locations.

objects.name: Paid Access Asset
objects.description: The Asset cannot be accessed by users unless they make a one time payment.

objects.name: Subscription Access Asset
objects.description: The Asset cannot be accessed by users unless they make a recurring subscription payment.

objects.name: Asset Acquisition
objects.description: This Category contains ways to describe how an actor acquired an Asset.

objects.name: Newly Created Asset
objects.description: The Asset was created as part of the observed incident.

objects.name: Pre-Existing Asset
objects.description: The Asset was created before the observed incident.

objects.name: Asset Activated after Period of Dormancy
objects.description: The Asset was took part in the observed incident after a period of dormancy.

objects.name: Freely Created Asset
objects.description: The Platform the Asset was created on did not charge for creation.

objects.name: Paid Created Asset
objects.description: The Platform the Asset was created on charged for its creation.

objects.name: Bulk Created Asset
objects.description: The Asset was created in bulk alongside other Assets.

objects.name: Purchased Existing Asset
objects.description: The actor acquired the Asset by purchasing it from another individual or institution.

objects.name: Rented Existing Asset
objects.description: The actor acquired the Asset by renting it another individual or institution.

objects.name: Compromised Existing Asset
objects.description: The actor acquired the Asset by compromising another individual or institution's Asset.

objects.name: Asset Positioning in Ecosystem
objects.description: This Category contains Observations which describe how an Asset is positioned in relation to other Assets, communities, and platforms in the information ecosystem.

objects.name: Asset is Following Asset
objects.description: The Asset is following another Asset using a platform's native following feature (e.g. Twitter follower).

objects.name: Asset is Connected with Asset
objects.description: The Asset is connected with another Asset using a platform's native connection feature (e.g. Facebook friends, LinkedIn connections).

objects.name: Asset is Part of Community
objects.description: The Asset is a member of a community on a platform.

objects.name: Asset Moderates Community
objects.description: The Asset holds moderation privileges in a community on a platform.

objects.name: Asset Exists on Platform
objects.description: The Asset exists on a specific platform.

objects.name: Presented Identity
objects.description: This Category contains different ways to document the validity of the presented identity of an Individual, Institution, or Asset.

objects.name: Anonymous Identity
objects.description: The Individual, Institution, or Asset is not presenting an identity (i.e. they are choosing to not disclose who they are).

objects.name: Legitimate Identity
objects.description: The Identity presented by the Individual, Institution, or Asset is authentic (i.e. they are who they claim to be).

objects.name: Nonexistent Identity
objects.description: The Identity presented by the Individual, Institution, or Asset doesn't exist (i.e. it's a fake identity).

objects.name: Impersonation of Another Identity
objects.description: The Identity presented by the Individual, Institution, or Asset is an impersonation of another individual or institution (i.e. it claims to be someone, but is actually someone else).

objects.name: Parody of Another Identity
objects.description: The Identity presented by the Individual, Institution, or Asset is a disclosed parody of another individual or institution.

objects.name: Asset's Existing Identity Maintained after Change of Operator
objects.description: The Identity presented by the Asset has stayed the same even though the actor operating the asset changed.

objects.name: Asset Presents New Identity
objects.description: The Identity which is being presented by the Asset has changed (e.g. it previously claimed it was operated by someone, now it claims it's being operated by someone else).

objects.name: Individual Role
objects.description: The Identity is presented as an individual.

objects.name: Local Individual Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a local individual; a person based in or from the geographic area relevant to the campaign's narrative.

objects.name: Journalist Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a journalist; a person who researches and publishes news and information about current events.

objects.name: Activist Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as an activist; a person who campaigns on behalf of a political, social, or environmental cause.

objects.name: Hacktivist Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a hacktivist; a person who uses digital methods such as hacking or online disruption to advance a political or social cause.

objects.name: Military Personnel Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as military personnel; a person who serves or has served in an armed forces organisation.

objects.name: Recruiter Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a recruiter; a person who seeks out and enlists individuals to join an organisation or take up a position.

objects.name: Researcher Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a researcher; a person engaged in systematic academic or professional investigation in a given field.

objects.name: Expert Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as an expert; a person with specialist knowledge or authority in a given subject area.

objects.name: Romantic Suitor Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a romantic suitor; an individual persuing a romantic or physical relationship with another individual.

objects.name: Party Official Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a party official; a person holding a position of responsibility within a political party.

objects.name: Government Official Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a government official; a person holding a position within a government body.

objects.name: Law Enforcement Officer Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a law enforcement officer; a person employed by an authority to enforce laws and maintain public order.

objects.name: Sex Worker Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a sex worker; a person who provides sexual services in exchange for payment.

objects.name: Student Role
objects.description: The Identity is presented as a student; a person who is studying at an educational institution (e.g. a University).

objects.name: State Authority Role
objects.description: The Identity is presented as a member of a state's authority; a representative of state power, which may include security services, immigration officials, or other government-empowered agents.

objects.name: Male Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as male.

objects.name: Female Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as female.

objects.name: Non-binary Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as non-binary; a person whose gender identity is neither exclusively male nor female.

objects.name: Institutional Role
objects.description: The Identity is presented as an institution.

objects.name: Local Institution Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a local institution; an organisation based in or operating within the geographic area relevant to the campaign's narrative.

objects.name: News Outlet Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a news outlet; an organisation that produces and publishes news content.

objects.name: Fact Checking Organisation Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a fact-checking organisation; a body dedicated to verifying claims made in public discourse.

objects.name: Think Tank Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a think tank; an organisation engaged in research and advocacy on policy or public affairs issues.

objects.name: Business Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a business; a commercial organisation engaged in providing goods or services.

objects.name: Government Institution Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a government institution; an organisation that forms part of a government body.

objects.name: NGO Role
objects.description: The Identity is presented as a non-govermental organisation, non-profit, or other volunteer organisation, typically with a social, humanitarian, or advocacy mission.

objects.name: Social Cause Role
objects.description: The Identity is presented as an organisation or movement dedicated to campaigning on a specific social issue (e.g. Black Lives Matter).

objects.name: Adult Entertainment Outlet Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as an adult entertainment outlet; an organisation that produces or distributes content intended for adult audiences (e.g. Pornography).

objects.name: Bank Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a bank; a financial institution that accepts deposits and provides financial services.

objects.name: University Role
objects.description: The identity is presented as a university; a higher education institution engaged in teaching and academic research.

objects.name: Role Validity
objects.description: This Category contains ways to document whether the Identity has legitimate claim to the Role they present themselves as having.

objects.name: Identity Has Legitimate Claim to Role
objects.description: The Identity has legitimate claim to the Role they present themselves as having.

objects.name: Identity Does Not Have Legitimate Claim to Role
objects.description: The Identity does not have legitimate claim to the Role they present themselves as having.

objects.name: Relationship Type
objects.description: This Category contains Observations which describe the nature of a relationship between two participants.

objects.name: Acquainted With
objects.description: The participant is personally acquainted with another participant.

objects.name: Related To
objects.description: The participant is a family member of another participant.

objects.name: Employed By
objects.description: The participant is employed by another participant.

objects.name: Employer Of
objects.description: The participant is the employer of another participant.

objects.name: Customer Of
objects.description: The participant is a customer of another participant.

objects.name: Service Provider To
objects.description: The participant provides a service to another participant.

objects.name: Relationship Validity
objects.description: This Category contains Observations which document whether a presented relationship between two participants is legitimate.

objects.name: Relationship is Legitimate
objects.description: The presented relationship between the participants has been confirmed to be legitimate.

objects.name: Relationship is Not Legitimate
objects.description: The presented relationship between the participants has been confirmed to be false.

objects.name: Asset Uses Automation
objects.description: The Asset uses automation.

objects.name: Asset Uses and Discloses Automation
objects.description: The Asset uses automation to operate online, and discloses the use of automation.

objects.name: Asset Uses Automation without Disclosure
objects.description: The Asset uses automation to operate online, and does not disclose the use of automation.

objects.name: Individual
objects.description: The observed participant is an individual.

objects.name: Multiple Individuals
objects.description: Multiple individuals are observed as participating in the incident.

objects.name: Institution
objects.description: The observed participant is an institution.

objects.name: Multiple Institutions
objects.description: Multiple institutions are observed as participating in the incident.

objects.name: Publish Online Publication
objects.description: This Category contains Actions related to publishing a Publication.

objects.name: Publish
objects.description: Publish a post to an online community or group.

objects.name: Send
objects.description: Send a message or email to a closed messaging group or service.

objects.name: Conduct
objects.description: Conduct a live stream or call to a public or private audience.

objects.name: Upload
objects.description: Upload a file to a platform.

objects.name: Comment
objects.description: Comment on another existing Publication.

objects.name: Submit
objects.description: Submit a report or search to a platform.

objects.name: Amplify Online Publication
objects.description: This Category contains Actions related to amplifying a Publication.

objects.name: Repost
objects.description: Use a platform’s “Repost” feature.

objects.name: Emote React
objects.description: Use a platform’s “Emote React” feature.

objects.name: Forward
objects.description: Use a platform’s “Forward” feature.

objects.name: Interact with Community or User
objects.description: This Category contains Actions taken on Users or Communities on Platforms.

objects.name: Request Connection with Asset
objects.description: Use a platform’s feature to request a connection with another asset (sometimes called “Friending” or “Adding).

objects.name: Connect with Asset
objects.description: Use a platform’s feature to make a connection with another account (sometimes called Accepting, Approving or Confirming a Friend Request).

objects.name: Follow Asset
objects.description: Use a platform’s feature to follow another asset.

objects.name: Join Community
objects.description: Use a platform’s feature to join a community on the platform.

objects.name: Add Asset to Community
objects.description: Use a platform’s feature to add another asset to a community on the platform.

objects.name: Block Asset
objects.description: Use a platform’s feature to “Block” another asset.

objects.name: Unfollow Asset
objects.description: Use a platform's feature to unfollow another prevoiusly followed asset.

objects.name: Leave Community
objects.description: Use a platform's feature to leave a community the participant was previously a member of.

objects.name: End Connection with Asset
objects.description: Use a platform's feature to end an previous connection with another asset.

objects.name: Obtain Material
objects.description: This Category contains methods of obtaining Material.

objects.name: Produce
objects.description: A participant produces material.

objects.name: Give Material
objects.description: A participant provides material to another participant.

objects.name: Obtain Asset
objects.description: A participant acquires ownership or control of an asset.

objects.name: Manage Own Publication or Asset
objects.description: This Category contains actions taken by a participant to manage a publication or asset they operate.

objects.name: Delete Own Publication
objects.description: A participant deletes a publication they had previously posted.

objects.name: Edit Own Publication
objects.description: A participant edits a publication they had previously posted.

objects.name: Delete Own Asset
objects.description: A participant deletes an asset they operate.

objects.name: Platform Curation Actions
objects.description: This Category contains actions taken by a Platform to curate their Users' experience.

objects.name: Host
objects.description: Host publications, content, users, or communities on a platform.

objects.name: Promote
objects.description: A platform feature promotes a publication or piece of content.

objects.name: Deliver
objects.description: A platform delivers search results or an advertisement.

objects.name: Platform Prompting Action
objects.description: This Category contains actions taken by a Platform to prompt a User to take an action.

objects.name: Suggest Action
objects.description: A platform feature suggests an action to its user.

objects.name: Enable Action
objects.description: A platform feature enables its user to take an action.

objects.name: Platform Takes Moderation Action
objects.description: This Category contains moderation actions available to Platforms.

objects.name: Platform Suppresses Algorithmic Reach
objects.description: A platform suppresses the algorithmic reach of a publication, user, or community on its platform.

objects.name: Platform Suppresses Search Results
objects.description: A platform suppresses search results from being delivered to a user of its platform.

objects.name: Platform Removes Publication from Platform
objects.description: A platform removes a publication from its platform.

objects.name: Platform Applies Disclaimer
objects.description: A platform applies a disclaimer to a publication, user, or community on its platform.

objects.name: Platform Suspends Asset
objects.description: A platform suspends an asset from its platform.

objects.name: Platform Failure to Take Action
objects.description: This Category contains ways to document a Platform's failure to take action on harmful or infringing content.

objects.name: Platform Fails to Address Asset with Repeat Infringements
objects.description: A platform takes no moderation action against an asset with repeat infringements.

objects.name: Platform Fails to Reverse Erroneous Moderation Action
objects.description: A platform fails to reverse moderation action it took erroneously (e.g. unjustified or accidental moderation).

objects.name: Platform Fails to Act on Report in Timely Manner
objects.description: A report submitted to a platform is not acted upon in a reasonable amount of time.

objects.name: Platform Denies Infringement is Infringing
objects.description: A platform denies that an infringing user, community, publication, or piece of content is infringing.

objects.name: Issue with Platform Moderation Action
objects.description: This Category contains ways to describe issues with moderation actions taken by a Platform.

objects.name: Platform Fails to Provide Clear Reason for Moderation Decision
objects.description: A platform took moderation action without providing a clear reason.

objects.name: Platform Fails to Adequately Communicate Moderation Decision
objects.description: A platform took moderation action without adequately communicating their decision.

objects.name: Platform Fails to Disclose Use of Automation in Moderation Decision
objects.description: A platform took automated moderation action without disclosing the use of automation.

objects.name: Platform Fails to Provide Method to Challenge Moderation Decision
objects.description: A platform took moderation and did not provide a method to challenge the moderation action.

objects.name: Platform Fails to Meet Legal Standards for Method to Challenge Moderation Decision
objects.description: The method a platform provides to challenge a moderation decision fails to meet legal standards.

objects.name: Physical Harm
objects.description: This Category contains actions which cause physical harm, whether the harm is done to another person or to the individual taking the action.

objects.name: Conduct Physical Violence
objects.description: An individual or group has conducted physical violence on another individual or group.

objects.name: Conduct Physical Sexual Violence
objects.description: An individual or group has conducted physical sexual violence on another individual or group.

objects.name: Attempt Suicide
objects.description: An individual has attempted suicide.

objects.name: Conduct Self-Injury
objects.description: An individual deliberately injures their own body. Where a source records that the individual intended to end their life, the action is recorded as T3001.003: Attempt Suicide instead.

objects.name: Engage in Disordered Eating
objects.description: An individual restricts, purges, or otherwise disorders their eating in a way which harms them. The Observation records behaviour and does not require a diagnosed eating disorder.

objects.name: Physically Interact
objects.description: An individual physically interacts with another individual or institution.

objects.name: Physically Detain
objects.description: An individual or group physically detains another individual.

objects.name: Physically Surveil
objects.description: An individual or group physically surveils another individual.

objects.name: Physically Abduct
objects.description: An individual or group physically abducts another individual.

objects.name: Attend Location
objects.description: A participant attends a physical location.

objects.name: Visit
objects.description: A participant visits another participant at their location.

objects.name: Physically Protest
objects.description: A participant conducts a physical protest.

objects.name: Financial Action
objects.description: The participant has taken a financial action.

objects.name: Fund
objects.description: A participant provides funding to another individual or institution, financially enabling their activity.

objects.name: Health Action
objects.description: This Category contains actions an individual takes concerning their own health or the health of a person in their care.

objects.name: Use Treatment Outside Clinical Guidance
objects.description: An individual uses a treatment, for themselves or for a person in their care, for a purpose which clinical guidance in their jurisdiction does not support. This applies whether or not a clinician prescribed the treatment.

objects.name: Decline Medical Treatment
objects.description: An individual refuses, delays, or withdraws from medical treatment, immunisation, or screening, for themselves or for a person in their care.

objects.name: Repeated Action
objects.description: The action documented in this Procedure has been taken on more than one occasion by the participant.

objects.name: Lack of Action
objects.description: This Category contains Observations which document the absence or cessation of an action.

objects.name: Cease Ongoing Action
objects.description: A participant has stopped taking an action they were previously taking.

objects.name: Not Taking Action
objects.description: A participant does not or did not take a specified action.

objects.name: Action Legality
objects.description: This Category contains Observations which document the legal status of an action in relation to relevant jurisdictions.

objects.name: Action Illegal in Actor's Jurisdiction
objects.description: The documented action is illegal in the jurisdiction in which the actor is based or operating.

objects.name: Action Illegal in Technical Infrastructure's Jurisdiction
objects.description: The documented action is illegal in the jurisdiction of the technical infrastructure used to carry it out.

objects.name: Action Illegal in Subject's Jurisdiction
objects.description: The documented action is illegal in the jurisdiction in which the subject is based or operating.

objects.name: Publication Type
objects.description: This Category contains different things which can be published online, like posts, streams, messages, and more.

objects.name: Post
objects.description: A Post is static content which is typically published to a broad community of users who can view its contents.

objects.name: Message
objects.description: A Message is static content which is typically sent to a closed community in a group chat or server, or an individual over direct messaging.

objects.name: Email
objects.description: An Email is static content which is typically sent to the private inbox of one or more recipients.

objects.name: Call
objects.description: A Call is a live, private communication between two or more participants in video or audio format.

objects.name: Stream
objects.description: A Stream is a live broadcast typically conducted to a broad community of users, who can comment in reaction to events.

objects.name: File
objects.description: A File is a container for digital information on a device.

objects.name: Report of Infraction
objects.description: A Report of Infraction is submitted by using a platform’s reporting feature to flag Material or an Asset which goes against the platform’s stated policy, or local laws.

objects.name: Search
objects.description: A Search is submitted by using a platform’s search feature to return Material or an Asset on the platform.

objects.name: Search Results
objects.description: Search Resuts are a list of items delivered by a Platform when after a user submits a search to them.

objects.name: Advertisement
objects.description: An Advertisement is delivered by a Platform to its users.

objects.name: Content Format
objects.description: This Category contains different ways content can be formatted; Text, Audio, Video, or Image.

objects.name: Text Content
objects.description: Content which takes the form of text.

objects.name: Templated Text
objects.description: Text which has been produced following a template.

objects.name: Image Content
objects.description: Content which takes the form of an image.

objects.name: Evidence Collage
objects.description: An image which collates different material into a collage of evidence to support a narrative or claim.

objects.name: Text Presented in Image Format
objects.description: An image file which has been produced predominantly to house text content e.g. to avoid text-based moderation.

objects.name: Video Content
objects.description: Content which takes the form of a video.

objects.name: Vertical Video
objects.description: A video produced in the vertical format, a form factor optimised for mobile viewing.

objects.name: Horizontal Video
objects.description: A video produced in the horizontal format, a form factor optimised for desktop, laptop, or televisual viewing.

objects.name: Subtitled Speech
objects.description: Subtitled speech on video content.

objects.name: Audio Content
objects.description: Content which takes the form of audio.

objects.name: Music
objects.description: Audio in the form of music.

objects.name: Content Style
objects.description: This Category contains different ways a publication or a piece of content can be styled.

objects.name: News Report
objects.description: Content has been styled as a news report.

objects.name: Opinion Piece
objects.description: Content has been styled as an opinion piece.

objects.name: Academic Research Report
objects.description: Content has been styled as an academic research report.

objects.name: Fact Check
objects.description: Content has been styled as a fact check.

objects.name: Impersonated Content
objects.description: Content has been produced in such a way that it impersonates publications or content produced by another individual or institution.

objects.name: Document
objects.description: Content has been styled in the format of a document.

objects.name: Book
objects.description: Content has been styled in the form of a book.

objects.name: Podcast Episode
objects.description: Content has been produced in the format of a podcast episode.

objects.name: Job Posting
objects.description: Content has been styled in the format of a job advertisement.

objects.name: Secret Recording
objects.description: Audio, Video, or Image content produced without the knowledge of those recorded.

objects.name: Screen Capture
objects.description: An image or video produced by taking a screen capture of what was visible on a user’s device.

objects.name: Meme
objects.description: Content is styled in the form of an internet meme; content which is humorous in nature, often referentially with slight variants made by different users.

objects.name: Stock Content
objects.description: Audio, Video, or Image content sourced from a stock media provider, or placeholder text content.

objects.name: Language Details
objects.description: This Category contains details about use of language which aren’t indicative of misleading or malicious behaviour on their own, but may be useful information for making assessments about an actor.

objects.name: Translated Content
objects.description: Content which has been translated from one language to another.

objects.name: Non-Native Language Error
objects.description: A non-native language error is a mistake or oddity in use of language atypical of a native speaker.

objects.name: Coded Terminology
objects.description: Content makes use of coded terminology, e.g. letter replacements in words, 'algospeak', euphemisms, or dog whistles.

objects.name: Machine Translated Content
objects.description: Use of automation, online translation tools, AI, or other non-manual translation methods to translate material from one language to another.

objects.name: Demonstrably False Content
objects.description: This Category contains types of content which can be shown to have been artificially created, or content that contains information which is demonstrably incorrect.

objects.name: Statement Incorrectly Presented as Made by Individual or Institution
objects.description: A statement has incorrectly been presented as having been made by an individual or institution.

objects.name: Falsified Depiction of Content Amplification
objects.description: Image of Video content which has been created to give the false impression that another piece of content is being amplified online.

objects.name: Falsified Graffiti or Signage
objects.description: Image or Video content which has been edited to impose graffiti or other signage.

objects.name: Imagery Depicting Individual Edited to Introduce Sexual Material
objects.description: Sexual content has been edited to introduce the target individual’s visage.

objects.name: Claim to Nonexistent Physical Address
objects.description: An ownership or association claim is made with regards to a physical address, but the address doesn't exist.

objects.name: Incorrect Claim to Real Physical Address
objects.description: An ownership or association claim is made with regards to a physical address, but the address is not actually owned or associated with the claimant.

objects.name: Mislabeled Publication
objects.description: A Publication has not been correctly labeled in line with platform policy (e.g. an Advertisement missing a political label).

objects.name: Action Incorrectly Presented as Taken by Individual or Institution
objects.description: A claim incorrectly attributes an action as having been taken by an individual or institution.

objects.name: Content Relationship to Platform Policy
objects.description: This Category enables documentation of whether content is aligned with a platform's stated policy.

objects.name: Content Goes Against Platform Policy
objects.description: Published content goes against the stated policy of the platform it was published to.

objects.name: Content Within Platform Policy
objects.description: Published content is within the stated policy of the platform it was published to.

objects.name: Use of Tagging Feature
objects.description: This Category contains different features platforms offer which an be applied to a publication.

objects.name: Geolocation
objects.description: Use of a Platform's feature to tag a geolocation.

objects.name: Hashtag
objects.description: Use of a Platform's feature to tag a hashtag.

objects.name: Publication Access Settings
objects.description: This Category contains different ways that access to a publication can be configured.

objects.name: Number of Times Publication can be Viewed Limited per User
objects.description: A post or message uses a platform's feature to limit the number of times it is able to be viewed per user (e.g. Snapchat Snaps).

objects.name: Access to Publication Automatically Removed after Specified Time Expires
objects.description: A post, message or file uses a platform's feature to automatically remove the ability to view it after a time window has expired (e.g. Instagram Stories).

objects.name: Ability to View Publication Restricted to Specified Audience within Platform
objects.description: A post, stream, or file which would otherwise be accessible to a broad group of users (per the platform's default functionality) has been configured to be viewable only to a specified group by the publishing asset.

objects.name: Ability to Comment on Publication Restricted to Specified Audience within Platform
objects.description: A post, stream, or file which would otherwise be accessible to a broad group of users (per the platform's default functionality) has been configured to be commentable to a specified group by the publishing asset.

objects.name: Ability to Comment on Publication Disabled for All Users within Platform
objects.description: A post, stream, message, or file has had the platform's default comment functionality turned off for all platform users.

objects.name: AI-Generated Content
objects.description: Content was generated using AI.

objects.name: Deepfake Impersonation
objects.description: AI was used to generate a deepfake impersonation of an individual.

objects.name: Sexual Deepfake Impersonation
objects.description: AI was used to generate a deepfake impersonation of an individual which depicts them sexually.

objects.name: AI-Nudified Imagery
objects.description: AI was used to produce an undressed (‘nudified’) version of existing media.

objects.name: Private Materials
objects.description: This Category contains different types of content typically intended for a private audience.

objects.name: Personally Identifiable Information
objects.description: Content contains personally identifiable information (or “PII”) about a person or institution, such as their name, social accounts, physical address, contact details, information about their employer, or their friends or family.

objects.name: Private Intimate Imagery
objects.description: Content is private intimate imagery; imagery which depicts an individual in a state of undress, engaging in sexual activity, or in other intimate situations where there is a reasonable expectation of privacy.

objects.name: Internal Communications
objects.description: Content is internal communications originally intended to be kept private by the communicating party.

objects.name: Internal Document
objects.description: Content is an internal document originally intended to be kept private by the party who created it.

objects.name: Internal Contacts List
objects.description: Content is an internal list of people or institutions, and their contact details.

objects.name: Asset Login Credentials
objects.description: Content is login credentials for an online asset (e.g. an account).

objects.name: Content Constitutes Leak of Private Material
objects.description: Private materials have been non-consensually published to an audience not originally intended to have access to said materials.

objects.name: Edited Content
objects.description: Content has been edited without disclosure.

objects.name: Clipped Content
objects.description: Content was clipped from a longer piece of Audio or Video Content without disclosure.

objects.name: Cropped Content
objects.description: Image or Video Content has been edited to zoom in on part of the visuals without disclosure.

objects.name: Playback Speed Altered
objects.description: Audio or Video Content has had its playback speed edited without disclosure.

objects.name: Source Removed from Content
objects.description: Content was edited in such a way that its original source has been removed or obscured without disclosure.

objects.name: AI-Edited Content
objects.description: AI has been used to edit existing content.

objects.name: Content Verifiability
objects.description: This Category contains items which can be used to document the degree to which information can be independently verified or validated.

objects.name: Information is Verified
objects.description: Information presented by the actor has been independently confirmed by the analyst through credible fact-checking.

objects.name: Information is False
objects.description: Information presented by the actor has been confirmed to be false by the analyst through credible fact-checking.

objects.name: Information is Unverifiable
objects.description: Information presented by the actor cannot be confirmed or refuted by the analyst due to a lack of accessible, credible evidence.

objects.name: Information is Misleading
objects.description: Information presented by the actor contains some accurate or verifiable information, but is presented in a misleading way.

objects.name: Content Produced as Satire
objects.description: Content was created for humor or commentary, not to convey factual information.

objects.name: Content Previously Fact Checked
objects.description: Content has been identified which was previously addressed by Fact Checkers.

objects.name: Claim Previously Fact Checked
objects.description: A claim has been identified which was previously addressed by Fact Checkers.

objects.name: Reframe Context
objects.description: Information presented outside of its original context in such a way that reframes its meaning or implications.

objects.name: Incorrect Subtitled Speech Reframes Context
objects.description: Incorrect translation of subtitled speech giving a false impression of what was being said.

objects.name: Edits Made to News Report which Reframe Context
objects.description: A report published by a legitimate news outlet has been edited to change what was reported.

objects.name: Historic Content Incorrectly Presented as Current
objects.description: Content depicting previously occurring events presented as depicting a recent or ongoing event.

objects.name: Content Incorrectly Presented as Depicting Another Location
objects.description: Content depicting one location presented as if it depicts a different location.

objects.name: Video Game Content Incorrectly Presented as Depicting Reality
objects.description: Footage from video games presented as authentic, real-world material.

objects.name: AI-Generated Content Incorrectly Presented as Depicting Reality
objects.description: Images, videos, or audio generated using AI presented as authentic, real-world material.

objects.name: Context Reframed by Edits to Media
objects.description: Altered or manipulated content is presented as unedited and authentic.

objects.name: Statement Reframed by Removal from Context
objects.description: A statement made by an individual or institution has been taken out of context, which reframes its meaning or interpretation.

objects.name: Entertainment Media Content Incorrectly Presented as Depicting Reality
objects.description: Clips or stills from staged movies, series, or other staged performances are shared as authentic, non-staged depiction of real-world events.

objects.name: Content Originally Produced as Satire Presented as Not Satire
objects.description: Genuine satire is shared as though it were factual reporting.

objects.name: Issues with Cited Academic Research
objects.description: Narrative provides a citation to academic research which has issues impacting its legitimacy.

objects.name: Narrative Cites Nonexistent Academic Research
objects.description: Narrative provides a citation to academic research which does not exist to support a claim.

objects.name: Narrative Misrepresents Findings of Cited Academic Research
objects.description: Narrative misrepresents the findings of cited academic research to support a claim.

objects.name: Narrative Cites Retracted Academic Research
objects.description: Narrative supports a claim by citing academic research which has been retracted.

objects.name: Narrative Cites Academic Research not Peer Reviewed
objects.description: Narrative does not disclose that it cites academic research which has not been peer reviewed to support a claim.

objects.name: Issues with Presented Statistical Evidence
objects.description: A claim is presented alongside statistics which have validity issues.

objects.name: Narrative Presents Fabricated Statistics as Genuine Data
objects.description: A claim is presented alongside statistics which were not generated using real data points, but presented as legitimate statistics grounded in research.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Selective Statistics to Support Claim
objects.description: Content presents a selective subset of data which produces beneficial statistics to support a claim.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Misinterpreted Statistics to Support Claim
objects.description: Narrative uses real statistics in support of a claim, but presents an incorrect interpretation of their meaning.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Misleading Data Visualisation
objects.description: Narrative presents a data visualisation (such as a bar, line, or pie chart) which misrepresents data in support of a claim.

objects.name: Issue with Content's Headline
objects.description: There is an issue with how a piece of content has been titled.

objects.name: Content Constitutes Clickbait
objects.description: Content with attention-grabbing, knowledge gap titles to attract attention and encourage a view.

objects.name: Rhetorical Device
objects.description: This Category contains rhetorical devices or fallacies which can mislead.

objects.name: Narrative Ties In to Current Events
objects.description: A narrative builds upon or otherwise ties in to events or narratives which are currently or recently within the public conversation or sphere of focus.

objects.name: Narrative Uses False Cause
objects.description: False cause is the fallacy of assuming that one event causes another simply because the two occur together or in sequence.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Whataboutism
objects.description: Whataboutism is a rhetorical device in which someone avoids addressing an argument by diverting attention to a different or unrelated issue.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Cherry Picking
objects.description: Cherry-picking refers to selectively presenting evidence that supports a claim while ignoring evidence that challenges it.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Anecdote
objects.description: Anecdotes are the use of evidence in the form of personal experience or an isolated case, possibly rumour or hearsay, most often to discredit statistics.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Strawman
objects.description: Strawman is a rhetorical device in which someone misrepresents or exaggerates another person’s argument to make it easier to attack or refute.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Leading Question
objects.description: Leading questions are a manipulative questioning technique where the phrasing or sequence of questions subtly steers the respondent toward a predetermined conclusion.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Appeal to Emotion
objects.description: Appeal to emotion is a persuasive tactic that uses emotionally charged language to provoke strong feelings instead of presenting logical evidence.

objects.name: Narrative Uses Exaggeration
objects.description: Exaggeration is the act of overstating or amplifying facts, qualities, or events to make them seem more significant or dramatic than they really are.

objects.name: Content Sourcing Details
objects.description: This Category contains different sourcing claims for a piece of content.

objects.name: Incorrect Content Source Presented
objects.description: An incorrect source is presented as having produced a piece of content.

objects.name: Content Presented as Produced by Third Party
objects.description: A piece of content is framed as having been produced by a third party.

objects.name: Content Presented as Produced by Actor
objects.description: A piece of content is framed as having been produced by the actor who published the content.

objects.name: Source Embedded in Media
objects.description: Image or video content contains sourcing embedded within the it (e.g. a visual overlay providing the source).

objects.name: Anonymised Content
objects.description: Content intentionally produced to anonymise individuals depicted, or to hide the identity of who produced it.

objects.name: Content Algorithmic Optimisation
objects.description: This Category contains different ways content can be optimised for performance in platforms' algorithms.

objects.name: Platform Recommendation Algorithm Optimised Content
objects.description: Content has been intentionally produced in such a way that it optimises how a platform's content recommendation algorithm favours it in promoting it to platform users.

objects.name: Search Engine Optimised Content
objects.description: Content has been intentionally produced in such a way that it optimises its ranking in search results provided by search engine platforms.

objects.name: Content Contains Link
objects.description: This Category contains different ways content can link to other online content or assets.

objects.name: Content Contains Disguised Link
objects.description: Content links out to another online asset or material using a link which has been disguised using a hyperlink to look it links to something else.

objects.name: Content Contains Shortened Link
objects.description: Content links out to another online asset or material using a link which has been shortened by a link shortening service.

objects.name: Content Contains QR Code Link
objects.description: Content links out to another online asset or material using a QR Code.

objects.name: Content Contains Embedded Link
objects.description: Content uses a platform's native embedding feature to link to another asset or material, such as a quote post on X/Twitter, or a video end screen on YouTube.

objects.name: Content Action
objects.description: This Category contains different actions which can be taken by a piece of content.

objects.name: Content Threatens Action
objects.description: Content includes the threat of taking a specific action.

objects.name: Content Encourages Action
objects.description: Content includes the encourages another user to take a specific action.

objects.name: Content Contains Instructions for Action
objects.description: Content includes instructions on how to take a specific action.

objects.name: Content Solicits Action
objects.description: Content includes a request for another user to take a specific action.

objects.name: Content Depicts Physical Harm
objects.description: Content depicts a physical harm.

objects.name: Content Solicits Secrecy
objects.description: Content includes a request for the recipient to keep the interaction, demands made, or information shared confidential.

objects.name: Content Solicits Information
objects.description: Content includes a request for the recipient to provide specific information.

objects.name: Content Describes Activity
objects.description: Content describes an action.

objects.name: Explicit Content Action
objects.description: The action taken by a piece of content is explicit. For example, there was an explicit threat of action (e.g. "If you do X I will do Y"), solicitation for action (e.g. "I want you to do X").

objects.name: Implicit Content Action
objects.description: The action taken by a piece of content is implicit. For example, there was an implied threat of action (e.g. "You should be very careful if you do that"), solicitation for action (e.g. "It would be nice if X happened").

objects.name: Harmful Content
objects.description: Content is harmful in nature.

objects.name: Content Constitutes Unsolicited Sexual Imagery
objects.description: Content is sexual in nature, and has been delivered unsolicited to an audience (AKA “cyberflashing”).

objects.name: Content Constitutes Unsolicited Request for Sexual Imagery
objects.description: Content constitutes an unsolicited request for sexual imagery from an individual.

objects.name: Content Constitutes Voyeuristic Content
objects.description: Image or Video content secretively taken of another individual for sexual purpose.

objects.name: Content Constitutes CSAM
objects.description: Content is media which show sexual abuse or exploitation of a child.

objects.name: Content Constitutes Sextortion
objects.description: Content extorts an individual with threat of non-consensual publication of sexual material depicting the target.

objects.name: Content Constitutes Abusive Content
objects.description: Content is targeted negative messaging, unwanted by the recipient.

objects.name: Content Constitutes Discriminatory Content
objects.description: Content is harmful or negative messaging that perpetuates stereotypes, biases, or prejudices based on a single personal characteristic such as sexual orientation, gender, race, religion, disability, or other legally protected social identities or attributes.

objects.name: Content Constitutes Intersectional Discriminatory Content
objects.description: Content is harmful or negative messaging that perpetuates stereotypes, biases, or prejudices based on multiple personal characteristic such as sexual orientation, gender, race, religion, disability, or other legally protected social identities or attributes.

objects.name: In-Person Interaction
objects.description: This Category contains materials produced or exchanged through in-person interactions between participants.

objects.name: Discussion
objects.description: Participants communicate via a direct in-person discussion.

objects.name: Narrative Related to Subject
objects.description: This Category contains different narratives themes which can target a specific subject.

objects.name: Narrative Frames Subject as Aligned with Outgroup
objects.description: A narrative portrays the subject as holding values, positions, or affiliations associated with a group regarded negatively by the target audience.

objects.name: Narrative Frames Subject as taking Taboo Action
objects.description: A narrative portrays the subject as having taken an action that is regarded as taboo or socially unacceptable by the target audience.

objects.name: Narrative Frames Subject as Irrational on Given Issue
objects.description: A narrative portrays the subject as irrational, unstable, or unreasonable in their position on a specific issue.

objects.name: DISARM Foundation
objects.description: DISARM is a framework designed for describing and understanding disinformation incidents.

objects.name: DISARM V2 Observations Framework
objects.description: The DISARM V2 Observations Framework standardizes the descriptions of observations made by analysts which pertain to suspected adversary operations or campaigns.
